newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CROWN FALLS ON RATE CUT TALK, TRADE FCASTS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CROWN FALLS ON RATE CUT TALK, TRADE FCASTS.

text.p: 1000 GMT - Czech crown falls further at midday to about 1.75 percent below the midpoint of its mark/dollar basket from -0.6 percent just after the opening, as investors speculate about a possible cut in interest rates this week and expect unfavourable March trade figures which are due to be released on Tuesday.
* Crown at 30.359 to the dollar, and 17.826 to the mark, implying a deviation of -1.75 percent.
* Central bank fixed the crown 1.73 below basket parity on Monday, at 30.357 to the dollar and 17.882 to the mark.
* Support level seen at minus two percent versus the basket.
